unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: Not measurable: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 (not supported) on both leased GPUs; observed NCCL channels use SHM/direct/direct, so no NVLink fabric counters exist to read.
unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Not measurable per collective: only device-wide NVML PCIe rates with ~20 ms native driver windows (unaligned to operators) are available; cumulative hardware byte counters require a successful collector-specific probe, which the capability probe reports as unavailable. Logical payload or memcpy sizes must not be substituted.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: No hardware-counter probe available; NVML device-wide utilization windows are not aligned to collective ranges and cannot attribute per-collective utilization.
unavailable_fields.nccl_waiting_vs_wire_ms: No collector separates in-kernel NCCL spin-wait from wire transfer for the in-step collectives: kernel durations include device waiting (rank 1 sum 200.62 ms vs rank 0 58.90 ms), and nsys timelines alone cannot split the two. Only the synthetic collective_calibration reference at observed sizes/dtypes is obtainable.
unavailable_fields.cross_rank_arrival_skew_ms: Cross-rank timestamp subtraction is prohibited by the observed clock policy; only clock-alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions (execution_timeline) are obtainable, and GPU readiness/consumer completion may remain unknown, so skew stays bounded rather than exact.
unavailable_fields.bucket_identity: Not an open dimension: already resolved by the torch collector via native correlation and observed gradient-storage membership (all 13 collectives matched, 0 unmatched communication kernels, bucket attribution recorded per sequence 21-33); retaining no ambiguous candidates.

plan.rationale: Objective is max-rank summed NCCL kernel duration for the accumulated step; torch_communication already ran and supplies the objective (rank 0: 58.90 ms, rank 1: 200.62 ms; 13 allreduces = 12 buckets of 28,351,488 B + last bucket of 157,541,376 B, fp32 SUM, all ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL on stream 17, transport SHM/direct/direct with 2 channels, NCCL 2.29.7, peer access disabled). Three questions gate any candidate: (1) what algorithm/protocol/channel decisions NCCL actually makes for these sizes/dtypes in a warmed worker - kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol, so nccl_tuning is selected to capture the real tuner choices and alternatives (e.g., RING vs TREE, LL vs SIMPLE, channel count) at 28,351,488 B and 157,541,376 B fp32 SUM; (2) how much of each kernel duration is inherent collective cost versus in-kernel waiting - collective_calibration is selected as a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference at the observed sizes/dtypes with correctness checks (treated strictly as a reference experiment, not a performance lower bound or critical-path estimate) to size the headroom implied by the rank-1 inflation (about 14.4 ms per 28 MB bucket and 22.7 ms first kernel vs 3.2 ms on rank 0); (3) whether the rank-1 wait originates in host submission ordering/synchronization - execution_timeline is selected for its separate plain Torch trace with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, per-device intervals and clock-alignment bounds for matching CPU submissions, accepting its limits (GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown; it never replaces a communication hook). Excluded: torch (already ran; supplies objective and bucket attribution), nsys (attribution is complete - 0 unmatched communication kernels, observed bucket identity, no CUDA graphs, overlap already measured at 4.37/10.58 ms - and timelines alone cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer), device_telemetry (device-wide NVML rates/utilization/memory with native windows, not per-collective bytes; NVLink unsupported; adds nothing to protocol or skew resolution), python_runtime (perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean scores or GPU durations; host ordering is covered by execution_timeline submit associations), binding_cost (no candidate exists yet, so parent-vs-passthrough comparison is inapplicable; would run in later candidate feedback if selected then), candidate_diagnostics (no candidate to diagnose). Selection is deliberately focused on the frozen objective; no workload, quality threshold, or provider configuration is changed.
